profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Strongmind | Team Lead
profile.summary: Staff Software Engineer with expertise in Ruby on Rails and full-stack development. Proven Technical Team Lead with a track record of delivering scalable, maintainable solutions and mentoring high-performing engineering teams.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead two engineering teams building scalable, production-grade features in Ruby on Rails within an Agile environment
* Architect and deliver multi-tenant solutions using Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus), PostgreSQL, and TailwindCSS
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and design sessions
* Drive AI integration efforts, embedding OpenAI and prompt-driven development into core products using tools like Cursor AI
* Collaborate cross-functionally to unblock projects, improve velocity, and support end-to-end product delivery

positions.title: Staff Engineer | Team Lead
positions.description:
* Lead sprint execution and ensure our team delivers on commitments.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with other product and platform teams to align on architectural decisions and integrations.
* Ship production code daily.
* Mentoring junior engineers through one-on-one support and by helping run our Junior Engineer Program.
* Champion engineering best practices to build maintainable and high-performing systems
* Drive the successful delivery of full epics/features, from design to deployment

positions.title: Engineering Specialist II
positions.description:
Responsible for planning, installing, and troubleshooting network architectures to support customers, both foreign and domestic . Responsible for maintaining customer satisfaction by regularly traveling to field environments in a network consulting and field support capacity.

• Expert customer consultant providing guidance and training to customer personnel in system design, mission development, operation, application integration, configuration, and troubleshooting techniques.
• Communicates pertinent information to and from customer with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Product Management.
• Manages installations, configuration, and administration of Cisco equipment in Tactical networks.
• Network design and implementation.
• Software development for Linux systems.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
Harris RF Communications is the leading global supplier of secure radio communications and embedded high-grade encryption solutions for military, government and commercial organizations and a leading supplier of assured communications systems and equipment for public safety, utility and transportation markets, with products ranging from the most advanced IP voice and data networks to portable and mobile single- and multiband radios. 

·         Provide pre-sales and/or post-sale technical support of company products/systems to both domestic and international customers.

·         Provide, present and interpret design, application and service information to sales staff and customers. 

·         Assess application of company products to meet customer needs. 

·         Prepare detailed product specifications to sales staff. 

·         Provide follow-up support in disseminating technical information on specific applications. 

·         Work with a dedicated team of Sales, Program, Marketing and Customer Service personnel supporting communication equipment. 

·         Responsibilities include providing technical assistance, installation services, repairs and instructional training of RFC and OEM products and systems. 

·         Uses basic and advanced voice and data communication techniques in the operation of military HF, VHF & UHF systems.  

·         Configures network devices and integrates peripherals using TCP/IP protocols.  

·         Communicates system capabilities to customers and creates detailed written reports of outcomes and actions.  

·         Travel to various customer locations worldwide.

positions.title: Signal Support Systems Specialist
positions.description:
Signal Support Systems Specialists are primarily responsible for working with battlefield Signal support systems and terminal devices. 

Duties performed by Soldiers in this MOS include:

Installs, maintains, and troubleshoots Signal support equipment and terminal devices. Installs, operates, and maintains designated radio and data distribution systems. Maintains selected electronic devices. Performs Signal support functions, to include providing technical assistance and training for user owned and operated automation and communications equipment. Prepares maintenance and supply requests for unit level Signal support. Operates and performs preventive maintenance checks and services on assigned vehicles. Installs, operates and performs preventive maintenance checks and services on power generators.

Supervises, installs, maintains and troubleshoots Signal support systems and terminal devices, to include radio, wire, and battlefield automated systems. Provides technical assistance and unit level training for automation, communication, and user owned and operated Signal equipment. Disseminates information services policy. Prepares maintenance and supply requests for unit level Signal support. Operates and performs preventive maintenance checks and services on assigned vehicles. Operates and performs preventive maintenance checks and services on assigned power generators.
